name: Lyle (United States)
description: Black field with blue and white edges along the hoist and bottom forming a letter L, a yellow star in the upper fly and the date 1870 in yellow in the lower hoist.
history: Lyle is a city in Mower County, Minnesota. The flag was adopted in 2020 (designed by Emma Wilde, a Lyle High School student, in a class on flags taught by Tyler Amick and adopted by the city council in 2020, according to Flags of the World citing the Austin Daily Herald).
